name: effects_tick_activation
description: DoEffectsTick (0x697D01ED, EF4) activates and rebuilds nothing on an ordinary tick (EF12): only a queued-file reload runs UpdateActiveVisualEffects. The draw-pass sweep ends in ActivateNewVisualEffects (0x00592A01). An effect that nests itself gets ten levels per activation: creation leaves 11 effects, 10 active; the effects tick activates none; the sweep activates ten more (21, 20).
